items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Memphis Slim used to like to go hear him sing it, but Memphis said to me personally, when I interviewed him about Joe

ctx.x: There’s something about seeing it live, you know, in a club, where it’s so spontaneous and you kind of catch that moment. It’s really fascinating.

Sometimes it’s just the greatest experience. To see Joe work live is always a great time. And to see people like Carmen McRae and to hear them live, it was so exciting, to hear her in Birdland sing “Skyliner.” It was just a real experience that you can’t describe.

Well you know you that was just kind of reading my mind, in describing — when you have to describe a musical performance, I would think it’s difficult and I have to compliment you on your various ways you describe people singing — you were talking about Jon Hendricks and different singers. It’s hard to put it into words sometimes, but you made me want to go listen to the records— © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We are filming for the Hamilton College Archives. This is Joe Williams and I’m Leslie Gourse.

ctx.x: Well it’s been wonderful to see you again.
